about_the_game:
A twin-stick shooter where you build, fight, and survive.

Construct deadly defenses, set up powerful turrets, and wipe out relentless enemy swarms with an arsenal of unique weapons and abilities. Strategize, adapt, and shoot nonstop—only the smartest and fastest will survive!

Play solo or team up in co-op—can you handle the chaos?

You work for Omni Mercs. When colonies fall, you are called. It’s your job to clean up the mess and eliminate all threats that wiped out human settlements. 

Use a variety of arsenal and build your base to repel waves of enemies. 

Build the ultimate base, packed with powerful turrets and essential structures like cloning units, radar systems, and more. 

Shape the battlefield by placing indestructible nodes to trap enemies in deadly mazes and block key routes. 

Strategic planning and quick thinking are your best weapons—survive, adapt, dominate!

Master your playstyle by customizing unlocked skills to fit your strategy!

Choose from four distinct classes, each with powerful, unique abilities.

Shape your character’s strengths with new skills and perks - the path to victory is in your hands!

Team up in CO-OP with up to four players and take on the enemy together!

Coordinate your tactics, combine unique abilities, and dominate the battlefield.

The more allies you have, the more chaos you can unleash!

Vast Arsenal

Fight waves of enemies swarming your base using 10 different weapons - each of them has two firing modes. Use them to create combo effects for maximum damage. Keep shooting as your second weapon is reloading in the meantime - NON STOP ACTION!

Campaign Mode and Survival Mode

Progress through more and more challenging missions in campaign or try to survive as long as possible in survival mode and compete with other players on the leaderboard.

Adapt your Strategy to your Enemies

Some are simple brutes, some will try to pull you into the horde, and some will create more enemies upon death. Build defenses that are best suited to eliminate swarming enemies. Know your enemies and then prioritize your targets to ensure your survival.

short_description: You don’t just shoot waves of enemies—you build, strategize and adapt to survive. You can create maze-like defenses, set up turrets and then jump into the action yourself with fast-paced twin-stick combat. Planning is just as important as shooting—think ahead or you’ll quickly get overwhelmed
